@@U03464@@
But you saw it!
That violence!
Here! Now!
Raging plutonic fire,
monstrous bursts of Aeolian gases
breaking through the ancient crust
of the level earth, so that instantly
a mountain came into being!

@@U03466@@
And what is that meant to prove?
If it’s here, it’s here,
and perhaps that’s all to the good.
Arguments like this are a waste of time;
they lead people around by the nose,
if they don’t watch out.

@@U03468@@
Look there!
Every rock and cleft is already aswarm
with myrmidons searching out a home:
ants and 俾格米侏儒们 and tiny Tom Thumbs,
and a host of other busy little bodies.

@@U03469@@
(To 荷蒙库鲁斯.)

@@U03470@@
You've never aspired to great deeds,
you've lived in quiet, hermitlike confinement—
so if you can adapt yourself to governing,
I'll see to it they crown you king of the mountain.

@@U03472@@
What does my 泰勒斯 say?

@@U03474@@
He says don’t do it.
Little folk give rise to little deeds;
but with the great,
little folk can rise to greatness.
translation:
@@U03464@@
但你看到了！
那种暴力！
这里！现在！
熊熊的冥火，
风成气体的巨大爆发
突破古老的地壳
水平地球，因此立即
一座山应运而生！

@@U03466@@
那是想证明什么呢？
如果它在这里，它就在这里，
也许这就是好事。
像这样的争论是浪费时间；
他们牵着人们的鼻子走，
如果他们不注意的话。

@@U03468@@
看那儿！
每块岩石和裂缝都已经温暖起来
与 myrmidons 寻找一个家：
蚂蚁、俾格米侏儒们和小拇指汤姆，
以及许多其他忙碌的小团体。

@@U03469@@
（致荷蒙库鲁斯。）

@@U03470@@
你从来没有渴望过伟大的事迹，
你一直生活在安静、隐士般的禁闭之中——
所以如果你能让自己适应治理，
我会确保他们将你加冕为山之王。

@@U03472@@
我的泰勒斯说什么？

@@U03474@@
他说不要这样做。
小人成就小事；
但与伟大的人一起，
小人物也能成就伟人。
